title: Christmas Lights Recalled by Pepe Ganga Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The light string can overheat and catch fire, posing fire and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 500.

title: BebeLove Recalls Baby Walkers Due to Fall and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The walkers failed to meet federal safety standards. Specifically, style number 358 can fit through a standard doorway and is not designed to stop at the edge of a step as required by the federal safety standard. title: 3T Design Recalls Cervélo Bicycles with Aduro Aero Handlebars Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The forward extension mounts can detach from the base bar while riding causing the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 1,300 in the U.S. and about 225 in Canada.

title: Lion Force Recalls Boys’ Puffer Coats Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Burlington Coat Factory
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 2,400.

title: Runway Global Recalls Girls’ Sugarfly Hooded Jackets Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Burlington Coat Factory
summary: The jackets have drawstrings in the hood around the neck area that pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 820.

title: Eastman Footwear Recalls Coleman Runestone Children's Shoes
summary: The metal rivets surrounding the holes where the shoestring is secured on the shoes can have sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 12,200.

title: Infantino Recalls Teething Toys Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The tail of the monkey can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 191,000.

title: Sterling Rope Company Recalls Sewn Cords Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Sewn cords break at a lower weight than published weight values, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 9,200 in the U.S. and 480 in Canada.

title: U.S. Polo Assn. Recalls Girl’s Jacket Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a band of material at the neck that can pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 1,400.

title: Lucent Ace Manufacturing Recalls LED Flashlights Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Academy Sports + Outdoors
summary: The battery can short and cause the flashlight's canister to rupture, posing a burn hazard to the consumer. Units: About 3,000.

title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The hip restraint on the passenger side can fracture, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1800.

title: LEM Products Distribution Expands Recall Including Previously-Repaired 5-Tray Food Dehydrators Due to Shock Hazard
summary: Damaged wiring in the food dehydrators can come into contact with a metal bracket inside the machine, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 3,000 in the U.S and 24 in Canada. This product was previously recalled in May 2013 for a fire hazard..

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from between the fuel tank and fuel tap, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Air Compressors Recalled by MAT Industries Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The terminals of the pressure switch can come into contact with the motor housing and electrify the air compressors, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 100,000 in the United States and 7,000 in Canada.

title: Visonic Amber Personal Emergency Response Kits Recalled Due to Failure to Signal Emergency Assistance
summary: Following a reboot or system reset, the Amber SelectX Base Stations can fail to operate and detect an emergency signal from the personal pendant. Units: About 1,700 (previous recall of 24,000 units in September 2013).

title: Mammut Recalls Crevasse Rescue Devices Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The pull cord lock cam can fail, posing a risk of death and injury during a rescue. Units: About 70 in the U.S. and 80 in Canada.

title: Rowe Fine Furniture Recalls Ottomans Due to Risk of Suffocation (Recall Alert)
summary: Young children can become entrapped inside the storage compartment of the ottoman, posing a risk of suffocation. Units: About 220.

title: Cork Block Stacking Toys Recalled by A Harvest Company Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at StorkStack.com
summary: Small pieces of cork can break off the blocks, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 720 sets.

title: STX Recalls Shield Throat Protector Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The Shield Throat Protector can crack or break when struck by a lacrosse ball, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 4,000.

title: Yamaha Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The off-road motorcycle's drive chain can detach and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,300.

title: BRP Recalls Ski-Doo and Can-Am Lithium-ion Rechargeable Batteries and Heated Gloves Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The glove's lithium-ion rechargeable battery pack can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 450 in U.S. and 1,200 in Canada.

title: Genie Recalls Garage Door Openers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The control board can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,000 in the U.S. and 8,000 in Canada.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles' throttle cable can melt on the exhaust pipe and fail to operate properly. This can cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 16,550.

title: Rollerblade USA Recalls Tempest Inline Skates Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The mounting holes in the boot and frame can be misaligned causing the boot to separate from the frame and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 11,800 pairs.
